final: WITH env AS (SELECT s.phasefactor AS phase, e.imgcount AS imgcount FROM scanenvironment e JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = e.zoneref), phase_totals AS (SELECT phase, SUM(imgcount) AS phase_total FROM env GROUP BY phase), overall AS (SELECT SUM(phase_total) AS overall_total FROM phase_totals), shares AS (SELECT p.phase AS phase, p.phase_total AS phase_total, CAST(p.phase_total AS REAL) / o.overall_total AS share FROM phase_totals p JOIN overall o ON o.overall_total IS NOT NULL), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares), kept AS (SELECT sh.phase_total AS phase_total, sh.share AS share, sh.share - a.avg_share AS diff FROM shares sh JOIN avg_share a ON a.avg_share IS NOT NULL WHERE sh.share > a.avg_share) SELECT SUM(phase_total), AVG(share), AVG(diff) FROM kept
